Adaptive Learning Assistant

An AI-powered learning platform that generates personalized study plans, provides Socratic tutoring, tracks mastery progress, and dynamically adjusts teaching strategies — built on PowerContext for persistent memory and context management.

Get Started →

Core Features

Four integrated modules work together to deliver a personalized learning experience that adapts to each student's needs.

📋

Learning Plan Generation

Automatically generates structured weekly learning plans based on course goals, student background, and topic complexity. Plans include milestones, objectives, and estimated hours — stored in PowerContext atomic memory for persistent access.

💬

Socratic Tutoring

AI tutor uses the Socratic method — asking guiding questions instead of giving direct answers. Conversations are tracked per session with context continuity, so the tutor remembers previous discussions and builds on them.

📈

Progress Tracking

Monitors mastery levels across topics, identifies weak and strong areas, and generates detailed progress reports. Uses PowerContext memory kinds (mastery, weakness, plan) to maintain a persistent student model.

🎯

Adaptive Strategy

Dynamically adjusts teaching difficulty, style, and focus areas based on performance data. Implements spaced repetition scheduling and automatically flags topics that need review — all state persisted through PowerContext.

System Architecture

Built on PowerContext for context management and DeepSeek for LLM inference.

Scope Hierarchy: Student └─ Course └─ Session PowerContext Memory Kinds: ● student_profile ● plan ● mastery / weakness ● session_state ● adaptive_state ● review_schedule Data Flow: User Input → Session Service → TutorLLM (DeepSeek) → PowerContext Memory → Adaptive Strategy

How PowerContext Powers Learning

Every student, course, and session is a Scope in PowerContext. Atomic Memory stores structured knowledge that persists across sessions and can be searched with full-text retrieval.

  • Scope hierarchy: Student → Course → Session
  • Atomic Memory with 7 knowledge kinds
  • Full-text search for instant recall
  • Session state persistence for conversation continuity
  • Experience artifacts for exercise tracking
  • SQLite storage (Windows) / seekdb (Linux/macOS)

Quick Start

Get up and running in 4 steps.

1

Clone Repository

git clone https://github.com/shizuguyuki-alt/powercontext.git cd powercontext/qoder/learning-assistant
2

Install Dependencies

pip install -e .
3

Configure API Key

export OPENAI_API_KEY="sk-your-key" export OPENAI_BASE_URL="https://api.deepseek.com" export LLM_MODEL="deepseek-chat"
4

Launch Web Client

python web/app.py # Open http://127.0.0.1:8090
